name: Sophie
source:
This is the story of Sophie's holidays, boring as ever. She doesn't realize that she may be the unluckiest girl on Earth. Will she survive through this summer? Or will she die?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22929]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
蘇菲的假期一如既往地無聊。然而，她並不知道，自己可能是地球上最倒楣的女孩。她能活著度過這個夏天嗎？還是會死去？

［摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22929]Lemma Soft論壇[/url]］
